description: On one dynaset over F (IDs 1-8; N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70; S alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd, Null; D with a time part, a repeated date and Nulls; Q x, Null, y), for each criterion [ ;;   ;; N ;; 1=1 ;; 1=0 ;; N = 40 N ;; N = (40 ;; ID IN (1,3) ;; N = ID * 10 ;; N > ID * 10 ;; UCase(S) = 'ALPHA' ;; Len(S) = 3 ;; N Mod 20 = 0 ;; ID = '3' ;; S = 3 ;; N = 'abc' ;; N = 20.0 ;; N = 2E1 ;; N = &H14 ;; NoSuch = 1 ;; [S] = 'beta' ;; F.N = 20 ;; N = 20; ;; N = 20 -- c ;; N = 20 /* c */ ;; N = DMax('N', 'F') ;; N = Int(20.5) ;; N = CInt('20') ;; S = Chr(97) & 'lpha' ;; N = Val('20') ;; Missing ;; Empty ;; Long 1 ;; Boolean True ;; Double 40]: FindFirst, then FindNext x1, with the same criterion; after each call read NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID. Asks which expressions (arithmetic, functions, domain aggregates, comment markers, hexadecimal and exponent literals, coercions, qualified and unknown names) the criteria engine evaluates, and which argument types (Missing, Empty, Long, Boolean, Double) it takes. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
